title: Risk and Resilience Factors in Learning Disabilities Population
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to report preliminary outcomes of executive function and psychopathology symptoms of a manual-based psychological intervention for adolescents diagnosed with learning disorders- I can succeed (ICS).
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Learning Disorder diagnosis
* Normal range IQ
* Regular class attendance

Exclusion Criteria:

* Suicidal ideation and psychosis
